$description: DataTable: its tokens at the compact density.

data-table-text-line-height.$description: DataTable: a line of cell text in taller rows (and the line P is measured against): 16px at Compact.

data-table-header-type-icon-size.$description: DataTable column header type icon: hidden in Compact (a 28px header row is too small for it).

data-table-header-type-icon-gap.$description: DataTable column header: no gap where the type icon is hidden (Compact).

data-table-view-column-width.$description: DataTable: the view column at the end of the header (the view menu's button): as wide as the checkbox column.
